thesis: This episode argues that tech companies often engage in performative social signaling or ideological overlap to manage public perception, while journalists operate like intelligence agents soliciting leaks from these platforms. The speaker suggests that traditional media outlets like the New York Times have lost their journalistic integrity, becoming essentially partisan blogs, and notes that some tech leaders are unresponsive to PR efforts.
